text:
deploy-bot: Starting phased rollout: release=v2.3.1 slices=[US:10%, EU:0%, APAC:0%] window=2026-03-21T00:00Z -> 04:00Z. smoke-tests=enabled. pin=auto

sasha: ACK. running quick capacity probe for US GPU pool now. will report p95 latency and queue depth.

kevin: Oncall awake. If we need to pause, prefer to pin EU immediately and hold APAC. what's rollback trigger set?

maria: Rollback triggers: p95 > 450ms for 5m OR error-rate > 3% OR queue depth > 120 per slot for 3m. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall.

julie: Product FYI — release notes posted: https://internal.redwood/release/2.3.1 (contains change to tokenizer caching). keep an eye on regen quality in EU canary once it unblocks.

deploy-bot: US warmup completed: success=92%, avg-p95=210ms, queue=18. Canary logs: no obvious OOMs.

sasha: CPU/GPU headroom check: US GPU util ~68%, spare capacity ~12 gpus across pool. good to open to 25% slice after 15m if metrics stable.

kevin: Agreed. I'll patch the runbook thresholds to include an immediate pin command if GPU headroom drops by >30% in 10m. snippet: `deploybot pin --region EU --version v2.3.1 --reason "protective hold"`

maria: Running the end-to-end smoke now (rerank + chat + embeddings). ETA ~7m, will post short logs at the end.

chao: Heads-up: APAC infra scheduled thermal maintenance at 02:10Z. Recommend we do NOT expand APAC until post-maintenance + 30m.

julie: Good catch. set region gating: APAC=manual until 02:45Z.

deploy-bot: US -> increased to 25% at 1769999999+900s. Monitoring: p95=225ms, error-rate=0.6%. No rollback signal.

sasha: EU can be staged to 5% if we see stable latencies in the next 20m. Maria, any anomalies in smoke?

maria: smoke OK except a transient 502 for reranker at minute 4, traced to a flaky external store. not related to model change. filed incident #INC-572. no rollback.

kevin: I'll keep manual control on EU pin until we confirm external store flakiness cleared. If external store recovers, we proceed to 5% EU. If not, we pin EU=hold.

deploy-bot: Noting a small uptick in tokenization latency in US (~+18ms). attributable to caching warmup. predicted to stabilize. No action.

sasha: Ok let's document decision: expand US->25%, EU->hold at 0->5% pending ext-store flakiness, APAC->manual after maintenance. Rollback criteria reiterated in runbook. I'll add a line to release notes.

julie: Approved. If any of the rollback triggers fire, default action = pin version to previous (v2.3.0) for affected region, notify PM/CS and open RCA ticket.

deploy-bot: Final: rollout state recorded. Links: dashboard=https://ops.redwood/rollouts/1769999999, logs=https://logs.redwood/1769999999. Will post update at 1770000300 or earlier on any trigger. :white_check_mark:
